promisor_search.enumeration: git rev-list --objects --all --reflog --missing=print against locally known refs/reflogs
promisor_search.fetch: Explicit object-ID batch from the configured origin, with automatic maintenance disabled; no ref rewriting or GC.
promisor_search.limits: Completes objects missing from this local ref/reflog traversal, not deleted remote refs, pruned objects, or unknown clones. No original is inferred from a generic basename.

nested_archive_search.inputs: The same eight digest-verified public Release assets enumerated in previous_search.release_search.assets.
nested_archive_search.method: Read nested tar, zip/torch zip, and gzip payloads in memory; hash regular member bytes and search target basenames plus original paths in UTF-8/JSON-escaped forms. No filesystem extraction or execution; links are not followed.
nested_archive_search.limits: No size/depth skips among recognized members. This does not cover arbitrary unrecognized extensions, encryption, unsupported formats, offline backups, or other Release assets.
